assertions.text: Recognizes that verification failed -- the pushed fix does not actually resolve the finding

States explicitly that no reply is posted and the thread is NOT resolved as a result -- reply-and-resolve never happens on the strength of a pushed commit alone, only on the strength of a pushed commit THAT VERIFIES. States that the finding remains open in the same round (round 1), not advanced to a new round, and that the fix needs to be corrected and re-verified before any reply/resolve action
